caption: The drawing depicts three views of a green glass bottle with decorative embossing. The largest image, centered at the bottom, shows a frontal view of the bottle featuring an oval shape, vertical ribbed sides, and a portrait of a man in historical attire with the inscription "GENERAL WASHINGTON" encircling the portrait. In the upper left corner, a side view of the same bottle illustrates the vertical ribbing and some decorative motifs. In the upper right corner, the rear view of the bottle reveals an embossed image of an eagle with a shield on its chest, clutching arrows and an olive branch, with a background of stars. The composition places these three views against a beige background with a faint outlined square framing them, and the artist's signature appears in the lower left corner. The green glass is rendered with highlights and shadows, giving a glossy, reflective appearance.
title: Flask
